parameters.query:
select litellm_model, temperature, max_tokens, nudge,
       price_in_usd_per_1k, price_out_usd_per_1k, impact
from model_routing
where impact in ($1, '__default__') and personal_data = $2 and active = true
order by (impact = $1) desc
limit 1;

select max_research_rounds, tavily_max_results
from research_parameters
where impact in ($1, '__default__') and active = true
order by (impact = $1) desc
limit 1;

nodes.name: Call Model Turn
nodes.notes: ADR-034/035: drives the agentic web-search loop (Model Turn v1). max_depth/tavily_max_results from research_parameters (by impact). Returns {completion, sources, calls[], totals}.
